purpose: Route AI assistants and developers to the smallest SwiftBiuX document needed for a plugin task.

documents.title: AI Development Entry
documents.loadWhen: The user wants to build a plugin with AI or does not know where to start.

documents.title: SwiftBiuX AI Skill
documents.loadWhen: Always load this first before generating or modifying a SwiftBiuX plugin.

documents.title: Quick Start
documents.loadWhen: The user wants to create the first plugin or needs a short end-to-end example.

documents.title: Scenario Selection Reference
documents.loadWhen: The request is described in plain language and the plugin architecture is not obvious.

documents.title: Manifest Basics
documents.loadWhen: The task only needs the minimal manifest contract, extensionKind, action wiring, or basic permissions.

documents.title: Manifest Icons
documents.loadWhen: The task only needs to choose or explain plugin icons.

documents.title: Full Manifest Configuration
documents.loadWhen: The task involves advanced manifest details, share targets, configuration UI, or host API contracts beyond the minimal manifest.

documents.title: Permissions
documents.loadWhen: The plugin needs clipboard, paste, file, network, notification, or other host permissions.

documents.title: File Workflows
documents.loadWhen: The plugin reads, writes, renames, moves, copies, saves, opens, or trashes local files.

documents.title: Network/API Checklist
documents.loadWhen: The plugin uses AI, translation, image generation, live web data, or any third-party/internal API.

documents.title: UI Patterns
documents.loadWhen: The plugin needs a custom window, preview, form, editable output, progress view, or interactive surface.

documents.title: Configuration Reference
documents.loadWhen: The plugin needs user settings, secure secrets, option fields, packaging, or catalog entries.

documents.title: Debugging
documents.loadWhen: The user reports errors, packaging failures, runtime failures, or UI debugging problems.

documents.title: Examples
documents.loadWhen: The user wants to copy or adapt an existing plugin pattern.

documents.title: Stable vs Beta
documents.loadWhen: The user wants to publish, test, or maintain stable and beta catalog channels.
